verdict_reason: Grouping by code from the selection keys is correct and tested; the JSDoc claims the panel shows what is on the notification, which is untrue for unsaved ticks, and carries rationale.

todos.issue: The selectedSummary JSDoc (lines 22-23) is untrue and carries rationale. 'What is on the notification so far' is wrong on every POST render: search.controller.js passes mergedKeysFromPayload keys, which include ticks not yet saved to the notification. 'so the trader never has to scroll a results list to find out' is a design reason, which the house rules keep out of code.
todos.fix: Must: the doc comment states only the contract (the chosen keys counted, headed and grouped by commodity code in the order given) and makes no claim about what is saved or why the panel exists. One way: 'The chosen species, counted and grouped by commodity code in the order given.'
